cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: Stay for the Hard Part
cards.instruction: Create increasing moments of emotional honesty to test whether someone remains present and supportive.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Leave the laptop shut a minute. Remember how I made you listen to a whole problem before fixing it? I haven't booked our anniversary trip.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I thought you just needed help with the flights.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I let you think that. I was relieved when the cheap seats sold out. Don't reach for another solution yet.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I won't. Is it the trip, or us?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Us. That's the question you used to avoid asking. I hoped a cancellation would say it for me. Can you stay beside me while I try to say the rest?
